% ================================================================
% EAL layout helpers
% ================================================================
\usepackage{xcolor}

\definecolor{ealkeycolour}{RGB}{0,128,0}
\definecolor{ealenglish}{RGB}{0,0,0}
\definecolor{ealtwocolour}{RGB}{112,48,160}

\newsavebox{\ealboxen}
\newsavebox{\ealboxtr}
\newlength{\ealglosswd}
\newlength{\ealglossraise}
\setlength{\ealglossraise}{1.15em}

% a tier 3 word, in English and in translation alike
\newcommand{\ealkey}[1]{\textcolor{ealkeycolour}{#1}}
\newcommand{\ealkeytr}[1]{\textcolor{ealkeycolour}{\ealtext{#1}}}

% One translated word above one English word. Built from kernel
% primitives, never a tabular, which would break wherever the sheet
% loads array, booktabs or tabularx. The box is as wide as the wider of
% the two, so a long translation pushes its neighbours aside instead of
% overlapping them, and it claims its full height so a table row or a
% TikZ node makes room for it.
\newcommand{\ealgloss}[2]{%
  \sbox{\ealboxen}{\ealkey{#1}}%
  \sbox{\ealboxtr}{\small\textcolor{ealtwocolour}{\ealtext{#2}}}%
  \setlength{\ealglosswd}{\wd\ealboxen}%
  \ifdim\wd\ealboxtr>\ealglosswd\setlength{\ealglosswd}{\wd\ealboxtr}\fi
  \leavevmode
  \makebox[\ealglosswd][c]{%
    \makebox[0pt][c]{\usebox{\ealboxen}}%
    \makebox[0pt][c]{\raisebox{\ealglossraise}{\usebox{\ealboxtr}}}%
  }%
}

% opens up line spacing around a block of glosses, so the raised
% translations sit clear of the line above
\newenvironment{ealglossed}{\par\linespread{2.1}\selectfont\ignorespaces}{\par}

% a whole translated sentence above its English counterpart. block level,
% so it does not belong inside a tabular cell
\newcommand{\ealpara}[2]{%
  \par\addvspace{0.5\baselineskip}%
  {\color{ealtwocolour}\ealtextblock{#1}}%
  \penalty200
  {\color{ealenglish}#2\par}%
  \addvspace{0.5\baselineskip}%
}

% ================================================================
% Vocabulary key layout
% ================================================================
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{matrix}

\colorlet{ealrulecolour}{ealkeycolour!35!white}

\newlength{\ealwordcol}
\setlength{\ealwordcol}{40mm}
\newlength{\ealmeaningcol}
\setlength{\ealmeaningcol}{\dimexpr\textwidth-\ealwordcol-3mm\relax}

% the gap between a word and the dots that lead away from it, and the
% widest a word can be and still leave that gap
\newlength{\ealwordgap}
\setlength{\ealwordgap}{2mm}
\newlength{\ealwordfit}
\setlength{\ealwordfit}{\dimexpr\ealwordcol-\ealwordgap\relax}
\newsavebox{\ealwordbox}

\newcommand{\ealwordlines}[2]{%
  \parbox[t]{\ealwordcol}{#1\hyphenpenalty=9999\relax
    \strut\textbf{\ealkey{#2}}}%
}

\newcommand{\ealentry}[2]{%
  \par\addvspace{1.6mm}%
  \noindent
  \sbox{\ealwordbox}{\textbf{\ealkey{#1}}}%
  \ifdim\wd\ealwordbox>\ealwordfit
    \ealwordlines{\raggedright}{#1}%
  \else
    \makebox[\ealwordcol][l]{\usebox{\ealwordbox}%
      \hspace{\ealwordgap}\textcolor{ealrulecolour}{\dotfill}}%
  \fi
  \hspace{3mm}%
  \parbox[t]{\ealmeaningcol}{\raggedright\strut #2}%
  \par
}

% The translated word and then its meaning, all inside one \ealtext
% rather than two. A right to left language then orders the word, the
% dash and the meaning itself; set as two runs, the word lands at the
% far end of the line and is read last.
%
% The tie keeps the dash with the word, so a meaning that wraps breaks
% after the dash rather than opening its second line with one.
\newcommand{\ealtrmeaning}[2]{%
  \ealtext{{\bfseries\color{ealkeycolour}#1}~\textemdash{} #2}}

% how a heading and the match-up grid sit on the page
\newcommand{\ealstart}{}

% As many copies of a body as fit go on one page, with a cut line
% between them, so a key of five terms is printed four to a sheet
% rather than taking one to itself. A body too tall to fit is typeset
% directly instead, so it breaks across pages rather than overflowing.
\newsavebox{\ealcopybox}
\newlength{\ealcopyht}
\newlength{\ealcutgap}
\setlength{\ealcutgap}{10mm}
\newcount\ealfits
\newcount\ealdone

\newcommand{\ealcut}{%
  \par\vspace{0.5\ealcutgap}%
  \noindent\hbox to \textwidth{%
    \color{ealrulecolour}%
    \leaders\hbox to 6pt{\hss\rule[0.55ex]{3pt}{0.4pt}\hss}\hfill}%
  \par\vspace{0.5\ealcutgap}%
}

\newcommand{\ealpage}[1]{%
  \sbox{\ealcopybox}{\parbox{\textwidth}{#1}}%
  \setlength{\ealcopyht}{\dimexpr\ht\ealcopybox+\dp\ealcopybox\relax}%
  \ifdim\ealcopyht>\textheight
    #1%
  \else
    \ealfits=\dimexpr\textheight+\ealcutgap\relax
    \ealdone=\dimexpr\ealcopyht+\ealcutgap\relax
    \divide\ealfits by \ealdone
    \ifnum\ealfits<1 \ealfits=1 \fi
    \ealdone=0
    \loop\ifnum\ealdone<\ealfits
      \ifnum\ealdone>0 \ealcut\fi
      \noindent\usebox{\ealcopybox}\par
      \advance\ealdone by 1
    \repeat
  \fi
  \newpage
}

\tikzset{
  ealmatchgrid/.style={
    matrix of nodes, ampersand replacement=\ealnextcol,
    row sep=4mm, column sep=24mm,
    nodes={anchor=west, inner sep=1pt},
    column 1/.style={nodes={text width=38mm, align=left, execute at begin node={\hyphenpenalty=9999\relax}}},
    column 2/.style={nodes={text width=82mm, align=left}},
  },
  ealanswerline/.style={ealkeycolour!70!white, line width=0.7pt},
}

\pagestyle{empty}
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}

\newcommand{\ealkeybody}{%
  \ealstart{\large\bfseries PictureSequencesExtension: key vocabulary}\par\medskip
  \ealentry{coefficient}{\ealtrmeaning{係數}{字母前面的數，表示有多少個該字母}}
  \ealentry{consecutive}{\ealtrmeaning{連續}{按順序一個接一個，中間沒有空隙}}
  \ealentry{difference}{\ealtrmeaning{差}{一個數減去另一個數時所得的答案}}
  \ealentry{digit}{\ealtrmeaning{數字}{書寫一個數時所用的0至9其中一個單一數字}}
  \ealentry{doubling}{\ealtrmeaning{加倍}{變成原來的兩倍大。}}
  \ealentry{equality}{\ealtrmeaning{等式}{表示兩個量相同的語句}}
  \ealentry{even}{\ealtrmeaning{偶數的}{能被2整除的。}}
  \ealentry{frame}{\ealtrmeaning{邊框}{圖片周圍一像素寬的邊框}}
  \ealentry{greater than}{\ealtrmeaning{大於}{比另一個數量更大}}
  \ealentry{integer}{\ealtrmeaning{整數}{可以是正數、負數或零的整數}}
  \ealentry{linear sequence}{\ealtrmeaning{等差數列}{一個每次上升或下降相同數量的數值列表}}
  \ealentry{multiple}{\ealtrmeaning{倍數}{把另一個數乘以一個整數所得的數}}
  \ealentry{multiply}{\ealtrmeaning{乘}{把一個數自身相加指定次數}}
  \ealentry{nth term}{\ealtrmeaning{通項}{由位置求出數列中任何一個數的規則}}
  \ealentry{odd}{\ealtrmeaning{奇數}{不能被剛好分成兩個相等整數的整數。}}
  \ealentry{parity}{\ealtrmeaning{奇偶性}{一個整數是奇數還是偶數}}
  \ealentry{pattern}{\ealtrmeaning{圖案}{形狀或物體序列中的一個圖形}}
  \ealentry{pixel}{\ealtrmeaning{像素}{數位圖片中一個微小的彩色正方形}}
  \ealentry{product}{\ealtrmeaning{積}{兩個或以上的數相乘時所得的答案}}
  \ealentry{pyramid}{\ealtrmeaning{金字塔}{由一排排像素組成、每排逐次加寬一個像素的形狀}}
  \ealentry{rectangle}{\ealtrmeaning{長方形}{一個有四條直邊和四個直角的平面圖形。}}
  \ealentry{remainder}{\ealtrmeaning{餘數}{當一個數不能分成相等的整數組時剩下的數量。}}
  \ealentry{sequence}{\ealtrmeaning{數列}{按照某個規則排列的一列數}}
  \ealentry{square}{\ealtrmeaning{平方；正方形}{計算一個數乘以它自己；也指有四個相等邊和四個相等角的平面圖形。}}
  \ealentry{square number}{\ealtrmeaning{平方數}{一個整數乘以它自己所得的結果，例如 1、4、9、16。}}
  \ealentry{squared}{\ealtrmeaning{平方；正方形}{計算一個數乘以它自己；也指有四個相等邊和四個相等角的平面圖形。}}
  \ealentry{sum}{\ealtrmeaning{和}{數目相加時所得的答案}}
  \ealentry{term}{\ealtrmeaning{項}{表達式的一部分，或數列中的一個數}}
  \ealentry{times table}{\ealtrmeaning{乘法表}{透過不斷加上同一個數而得出的數列，例如 3、6、9、12。}}
  \ealentry{total}{\ealtrmeaning{總和}{把所有部分加在一起所得的整體數量。}}
  \ealentry{triangular number}{\ealtrmeaning{三角形數}{可以用排列成三角形的點表示出來的數}}
  \ealentry{whole number}{\ealtrmeaning{非負整數}{不是負數，且小數點後沒有部分的數，例如 0、1、2 或 3。}}
}

  {\textbf{\ealkey{consecutive}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{等式}{表示兩個量相同的語句}} \\

  {\textbf{\ealkey{digit}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{加倍}{變成原來的兩倍大。}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{doubling}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{係數}{字母前面的數，表示有多少個該字母}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{equality}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{等差數列}{一個每次上升或下降相同數量的數值列表}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{even}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{大於}{比另一個數量更大}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{frame}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{差}{一個數減去另一個數時所得的答案}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{greater than}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{倍數}{把另一個數乘以一個整數所得的數}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{integer}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{奇數}{不能被剛好分成兩個相等整數的整數。}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{linear sequence}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{整數}{可以是正數、負數或零的整數}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{multiple}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{偶數的}{能被2整除的。}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{multiply}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{邊框}{圖片周圍一像素寬的邊框}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{nth term}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{奇偶性}{一個整數是奇數還是偶數}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{odd}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{通項}{由位置求出數列中任何一個數的規則}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{parity}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{長方形}{一個有四條直邊和四個直角的平面圖形。}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{pattern}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{積}{兩個或以上的數相乘時所得的答案}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{pixel}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{乘}{把一個數自身相加指定次數}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{product}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{數列}{按照某個規則排列的一列數}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{pyramid}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{圖案}{形狀或物體序列中的一個圖形}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{rectangle}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{餘數}{當一個數不能分成相等的整數組時剩下的數量。}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{remainder}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{平方；正方形}{計算一個數乘以它自己；也指有四個相等邊和四個相等角的平面圖形。}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{sequence}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{像素}{數位圖片中一個微小的彩色正方形}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{square}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{項}{表達式的一部分，或數列中的一個數}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{square number}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{金字塔}{由一排排像素組成、每排逐次加寬一個像素的形狀}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{squared}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{和}{數目相加時所得的答案}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{sum}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{乘法表}{透過不斷加上同一個數而得出的數列，例如 3、6、9、12。}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{term}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{非負整數}{不是負數，且小數點後沒有部分的數，例如 0、1、2 或 3。}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{times table}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{平方；正方形}{計算一個數乘以它自己；也指有四個相等邊和四個相等角的平面圖形。}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{total}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{平方數}{一個整數乘以它自己所得的結果，例如 1、4、9、16。}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{triangular number}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{總和}{把所有部分加在一起所得的整體數量。}} \\
  {\textbf{\ealkey{whole number}}} \ealnextcol {\ealtrmeaning{三角形數}{可以用排列成三角形的點表示出來的數}} \\
}
